hero.text: A ceremony should fit like a warm coat. I listen, write your story down and speak it as if I had been there myself.

marqueeText: Ja, ik wil · Ja, ich will · Yes, I do

about.paragraph1Before: Twenty-five years married to Ron, mother of Matthijs, Jesse and Nino, and a Texel islander through and through. My motto is
about.paragraph2: In our conversations we get to know each other properly. Everything I hear I connect with a piece of my own creativity. What comes out is a speech nobody else could have written, because it is only about you.

ceremoniesIntro.title: Four ways to say yes
ceremoniesIntro.text: From a legally binding marriage to a ceremony without any rules — or both, on the same day. All four in Dutch, German or English.

ceremonies.title: Legal marriage
ceremonies.description: Sworn in as a registrar with the municipality of Den Helder — and able to travel to almost any other Dutch municipality.
bullets: Legally valid, with two to four witnesses
‘Registrar for a day’: I arrange the swearing-in
Marriage certificate through your own municipality

ceremonies.title: Celebrant ceremony
ceremonies.description: No rules, no time slot, no town hall. In the place and at the moment that suits you.
bullets: Any location, any day, any time

ceremonies.title: Vow renewal
ceremonies.description: Married long ago, plenty of life in between, still together. Say it out loud one more time.
bullets: Perfect for an anniversary or a new chapter
Children and grandchildren can take part
The same care as a first ceremony

ceremonies.title: Commitment without paperwork
ceremonies.description: A promise to each other, without legal consequences — entirely on your own terms.
bullets: For partners, friends or chosen family
No trip to the town hall required
Prepared just as personally as any other ceremony

werkwijze.title: From the first cup of coffee to the moment you say yes

steps.title: Getting to know each other
steps.text: No strings attached, at my home or over video call. We talk about you, not about packages. Does it click? Only then do we talk dates.

steps.title: Your story
steps.text: Two conversations in which I hear everything. Including the things you do not find special yourselves — those are exactly what makes the speech personal.

steps.title: The speech
steps.text: I write, you read along and steer. Surprises we save for the day itself, the rest is exactly the way you want it.

steps.title: The day itself
steps.text: I arrive early, coordinate with your photographer and venue, and then the moment is there. All that is left for you is to say yes.

locationsIntro.title: Places on Texel I recommend myself
locationsIntro.text: I know the island and the people who work here. Tell me what kind of feeling you are after and I will think along.

faq.a: € 825, including all conversations and the written speech. A German-language ceremony is € 125 extra. Travel costs and any municipal fees come on top of that.

faq.q: Can we take you along to our own municipality?
faq.a: Yes. Almost every Dutch municipality offers the ‘registrar for a day’ arrangement. I take care of the swearing-in; alongside the municipal fees you will receive my invoice.
Dutch, German and English. A bilingual ceremony is possible too — many couples choose that when the family comes from two countries.

faq.q: How far in advance should we book?
faq.a: Six to twelve months is common, but always ask. Sometimes there is room in three weeks.
Then there is a plan B, which we work out together well in advance. Texel weather holds no surprises for me.

contact.text: Leave your date and a few words. I usually reply within a day and will send a no-obligation quote.
